chunk_identity_sha256_definition: SHA-256 over, for each chunk in ingestion order, chunk_id, NUL, content_sha256, NUL. Measured on 2026-09-30 from the corpus that reproduced the receipt digest; it is not a value stored in the S56-C receipt, and it is independent of BM25 tokenization.
scope: Archived benchmark corpus only; not the current product corpus or live model/answer qualification. Source PDFs and raw archival receipt stay private.
